name: Cobalt Grid
avoid_for: Decks that need warmth, multi-colour energy, or a casual / playful voice — the strict cobalt + cream + grid palette is intentionally austere
weak_cases: Two inks limit categorical encoding; pixel counts must represent values and decorative mosaics are not QR codes.
visual_signature: Permanent graph paper, cream/cobalt printing and serif/sans/mono hierarchy.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Mono catalogue labels and serif emphasis need script-aware equivalents; grids cannot compensate for unsupported glyphs.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
